policy_name: Summit Health Plan MP-ORTHO-031: Total Knee Arthroplasty (illustrative)

criteria.criterion: Criterion 1 - Weight-bearing X-rays within 12 months show KL grade 3-4, bone-on-bone or severe joint space narrowing
criteria.evidence: 3-view weight-bearing right knee X-rays on {{XRAY}} show severe medial narrowing with bone-on-bone apposition, KL grade 4.

citation.excerpt: Severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis, medial predominant, Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4.

criteria.action_needed: None - the report was included in the original request.

criteria.criterion: Criterion 2 - Moderate-severe pain and functional impairment for 3+ months, documented with a validated measure
criteria.evidence: Pain 8/10 for more than 3 years, walking tolerance under 1 block, cane use, night pain; KOOS JR 44.8 at the surgical consult.

citation.excerpt: Walking tolerance under 1 block. Uses a cane... KOOS JR today: 44.8.

criteria.criterion: Criterion 3 - Failure of 12+ weeks of non-operative treatment in the past 12 months, including at least two modalities, with PT supported by therapy notes
criteria.evidence: The chart documents PT {{PT_START}} to {{PT_END}} (14 visits, about 12 weeks, plateaued), meloxicam for more than 12 months, and corticosteroid injections on {{INJ1}} and {{INJ2}}. The PT discharge summary was NOT sent with the original request, which is the stated reason for the denial.

citation.excerpt: Visits attended: 14 of 16 scheduled... Patient participated fully but plateaued with persistent pain and functional limitation.

criteria.action_needed: Attach the Northgate PT discharge summary and both injection procedure notes; once attached, this criterion is met.

criteria.criterion: Criterion 4 - BMI below 40 or a documented optimization plan
criteria.evidence: BMI 31.4 with weight counseling and a 9 lb weight loss documented.

citation.excerpt: Weight counseling provided (BMI 31.4); patient lost 9 lb over 6 months.

criteria.criterion: Criterion 5 - No active infection; HbA1c below 8.0% within 3 months for diabetic patients
criteria.evidence: HbA1c 6.4% about 2 months before the consult; no history of knee infection; skin intact.

citation.excerpt: Type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 6.4% two months ago)... No history of knee infection. Skin intact.

criteria.action_needed: Attach the HbA1c lab result; confirm it falls within 3 months of the surgery date or repeat it at pre-op.

criteria.evidence: The consult documents a risks/benefits/alternatives discussion and the patient's decision to proceed.

citation.excerpt: Risks, benefits and alternatives discussed; shared decision-making completed and the patient wishes to proceed.

overall_assessment: Every MP-ORTHO-031 criterion is supported by the chart. The denial resulted from a documentation gap (PT notes not sent), not from a clinical shortfall. With the PT discharge summary and injection notes attached, all six criteria are met.
gaps: HbA1c lab report is referenced but not in the uploaded record.
The PT plan of care called for 16 visits and 14 were attended; frame this as full participation with a plateau.
